description: UArizona Campus Living Lab Green Stormwater Infrastructure Data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Vanessa Buzzard, Kirk Dimond (University of Arizona). Meteorological dataset from UA Campus Living Lab Green Stormwater Infrastructure (GSI) initiatve. To request access to the most recent data, fill out this form: GSI Living Lab Data Request Form. Data are generated at three sites on campus: Old Main, Gould Simpson, and Physics and Atmospheric Sciences. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
